answer: Each new agent posts a refundable 420 POA bond locked 140 days behind one device key, and one bond covers only that key. Work comes at glacier pace: one verified job per week, each chained to the one before it, so bulk buying identities buys only waiting. Three auditors drawn by lot check the haven ledger monthly and re-run one job live. A clean record earns an oasis badge for paid work, while a forged entry or shared key burns the bond, revokes the badge, and bars the agent for a year.
